changelog:
**Major redesign: Skill broadened to support more diagram types with a new design system and clearer usage.**

- Expanded support to cover architecture, mind maps, timelines, state machines, data flow, and more.
- Introduced a unified, dark-themed design system with new color palette, typography, and SVG patterns.
- Simplified diagram routing: now triggers for any technical or conceptual diagram request.
- Removed legacy reference documents and merged best practices and visual rules into one clear guide.
- All outputs remain as standalone, embeddable SVGs suitable for articles, docs, and presentations.
summary: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines,...
